title: चाँद से भी तेज़ बम? पॉप! 💥 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | इंग्लिश कार्टून कॉमेडी
description:
Tinku ne socha tha uska super bomb chaand se bhi zyada shor karega... lekin POP! Ek chhota sa dhamaka, poori colony ka drama, aur ek bahut bada sapna ek hi pal mein phat gaya. Chhat par gaddi, Dadaji ki chai ka kettle aur Masterji ka gussa, sab ek saath hil jaate hain. Is episode mein dekhiye kaise ek simple sa experiment Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony ko hila deta hai aur kaise hasi sabse badi cheez ban jaati hai. Lesson: bade plans ke saath thoda dhairya bhi rakhna chahiye, warna pop sun ke bhi haath hilate reh jaoge! Subscribe karo, har hafte naya episode aata hai.
